facts.fact: Fisch 在 LA 韩国城等迟到的哥哥 Jim（GlobalVill 联合创始人/silent partner）
facts.anchor: He was waiting for his older brother, the co-founder and silent partner of GlobalVill.com, the tech company Fisch had launched three years earlier.

facts.fact: Jim 迟到三十分钟、叫 Fisch 小名 little guy、吃他盘子里的寿司
facts.anchor: “Hey there, little guy,” Jim said once he arrived thirty minutes late.

facts.fact: Jim 自夸 Erin 之局：追踪电线读数、Craigslist 雇人假扮 crooked、编童话
facts.anchor: I hired some call girls off Craigslist to record themselves pretending to be ‘crooked people’ fresh back from Public Access Afterworld, made up this whole elaborate fairy tale

facts.fact: Jim 自曝化名 Jim Davis（像 Garfield 那位）
facts.anchor: guess what I told them my last name was? This is the best part. Davis. Jim Davis. Like the Garfield guy.

facts.fact: Fisch 质疑读数爆表危险、Jim 没测；Jim 嘲笑 receiver 是 old wives' tale
facts.anchor: “Could have been the what?” Jim shot back. “The receiver? You still believe in that old wives’ tale, even after all these years?”

facts.fact: Fisch 承认 Erin 不是 receiver（电气级数不够高）、但下一个可能是
facts.anchor: She wasn’t. Her electrical levels weren’t quite high enough. But that doesn’t mean the next one won’t be.

facts.fact: Jim 说这是自己的战绩、Fisch 用公司和怪物线人继续——追线法是 Grandpa 教的
facts.anchor: Trace the lines. Follow the heat. Find the crooked, just like Grandpa taught us.

facts.fact: Fisch 自称为了护世界而做、Jim 戳穿他享受其中；末句「看着我的眼睛说你不像我一样喜欢让女孩消失」
facts.anchor: Look me in the eye, little guy, and tell me you don’t get off on making those girls disappear just like I do.
